name: Associative Image Compositing
aliases: Parallel Image Compositing with Associative Operator
definition: A method to blend snapshots of sub-volumes rendered independently by distributed nodes, allowing any geometrically coherent group of sub-volumes to be blended together while respecting distance/priority order.
summary: Associative Image Compositing blends independently rendered sub-volume snapshots using an associative operator, distinguishing itself by treating compositing as a direct blend rather than separating shading from global blending.
